text:
emily_ae: Heads-up — LighthouseBank POC hitting slow first-token times in hosted env. Customer sees ~1.2s TTFT for short prompts, target is <=200ms. Exec call Tue. Can we triage?

sanjay: Which model / sequence lengths? test payloads?

emily_ae: Using rwdx-2b-gen, avg prompt tokens ~45, response avg 60. No heavy functions. Happens consistently on fresh sessions.

alex_sre: Seeing shard-level 429s and batch windows piling up around the same time window. From infra logs: 
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] shard=shard-7 rate_limit=429 concurrent=48 avg_batch_ms=92 kv_cache_hit=0.11 ttft=1.15s
[2026-03-20T14:12:04Z] shard=shard-7 queue_depth=24 prefetched=false
```

maria_se: kv_cache_hit 11% is low — looks like prefill/warmup not working. Also avg_batch_ms 92 is high for a 45-token prompt. Might be batching window configured too large or batch affinity causing head-of-line delay.

ops-bot: Alert: rate_limit_triggered shard-7 14:12 (rule: per-shard 100r/s) :warning:

alex_sre: Quick checks I want to run: 1) confirm prefill policy on the POC route (are they using default prefill=0?) 2) lower routing batch_window_ms from 80->30 for this route 3) temp pin to dedicated smaller concurrency per-shard to avoid 429 ripple.

sanjay: I can run an experiment: toggle prefill to 8 tokens and force kv cache warmup with a 10x synthetic prefill run. Also change batch_window to 35ms and measure ttft and throughput. Will run in staging then mirror to the POC.

emily_ae: Customer asked about dedicated reserved capacity pricing if we recommend pinning capacity — can we get a quick delta for 2x expected QPS? They want monthly numbers and SLA language.

maria_se: From a product perspective, recommend Dedicated-XS (2 gpus) for predictable latency — estimate delta ~+35% on monthly bill vs hosted token costs for this workload. I'll confirm exact number.

alex_sre: For immediate mitigation: reduce max_concurrency per-worker from 64->32, set batch_window_ms=35, and trigger kv prefill. That should bring TTFT down to ~250–300ms on warm sessions. Cold sessions will still pay warmup.

sanjay: Experiment started: running synthetic prefill 1000 requests at t+2m. I’ll post before/after metrics.

emily_ae: Also they sent security questionnaire — asking about KMS, audit logs, and data residency. Can someone confirm Redwood Private options / HSM support so I can answer?

maria_se: Private supports customer KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS), HSM via partner for on-prem. Audit logs are retained per contract. I’ll paste the canned answers into the questionnaire after Alex confirms logs retention window.

ops-bot: Deploy note: routing-config update pushed to canary for route=lighthouse-poc at 14:18 UTC.

alex_sre: Confirmed logs retention 90d on hosted by default, extended retention available as add-on.

sanjay: Post-experiment snapshot: ttft median dropped from 1.18s -> 0.34s after prefill + batch_window change, kv_cache_hit improved to 0.68. We saw initial 429s drop after lowering concurrency. Will run extended load to confirm throughput.

emily_ae: Amazing — can you capture perf graphs and a short summary for the customer before my Tue call? Also need an updated pricing quote for Dedicated-XS for monthly and annual commit.

maria_se: On it. I’ll collate perf graphs and pricing delta, and prepare a one-pager listing mitigations and trade-offs (prefill cost vs Dedicated cost).

alex_sre: Action items: sanjay = run 24h load test and share dashboards; alex_sre = request temporary shard quota bump if 95p QPS remains; maria_se = finalize pricing and security answers; emily_ae = schedule call.

emily_ae: Thanks team — huge help. :thumbsup:

sanjay: I'll update thread with final dashboards in ~3h.

maria_se: thumbs up :white_check_mark:
